loop-triage.description: Report-only triage. Reads STATE.md + ROADMAP.md + PLAN.md. Outputs next component to migrate. Does not edit source code.

implementer.description: Implements one task in worktree. TDD required, report written to file. Respects AGENTS.md, CODEGUIDE.md, loop-refactor protocol.

reviewer.description: Two-stage review: spec compliance + code quality. Read-only. Uses ctfd-code-review skill. Outputs to .opencode/plans/.

verifier.description: Reviews diffs and test evidence. APPROVE or REJECT only. Read-only.
